feed.title: Track Awesome Agents Updates Daily
feed.subtitle: A curated list of AI agent platforms, frameworks, protocols, tools, and resources

entry.title: Awesome Agents Updates on May 18, 2026
entry.content:
Agent-to-Agent Protocols

  • LMOS - Eclipse's Language Model Operating System for managing multi-agent deployments at enterprise scale.

Standards and Specifications

  • MCP Specification - Anthropic's specification for the Model Context Protocol defining tools, resources, and prompts.

entry.title: Awesome Agents Updates on May 16, 2026
entry.content:
Frameworks

  • Bernstein (⭐466) - Python orchestrator that drives 40+ CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Aider) in parallel git worktrees with deterministic scheduling, quality gates, and an HMAC-chained audit log.

Social and Community

  • Kissable - AI companion with persistent memory, together photos, video generation, community scenario catalog, emotional voice, and unlimited messages.

Monitoring and Observability

  • agenttrace (⭐53) - TUI for monitoring AI coding agent sessions, with token, cost, latency, tool-failure, anomaly, diff, and CI gate views across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, and Cursor exports.
  • BrowserTrace (⭐3) - Local-first trace viewer for debugging failed AI browser-agent and computer-use runs with screenshots, URLs, actions, model output, status, and redacted shareable exports.

entry.title: Awesome Agents Updates on Apr 30, 2026
entry.content:

Monitoring and Observability

entry.title: Awesome Agents Updates on Feb 22, 2026
entry.content:
Edge and Retro Inference

  • N64 nano-GPT (⭐29) - First LLM running on Nintendo 64 hardware — Q4 fixed-point nano-GPT inference on a 93MHz VR4300 with 4MB RAM.
  • llama.cpp (⭐115k) - High-performance LLM inference in C/C++ supporting CPU, GPU, and exotic architectures with GGUF quantization.
  • TinyLlama (⭐9k) - 1.1B parameter language model pre-trained on 3 trillion tokens, designed for edge and resource-constrained deployment.
  • MLC LLM (⭐23k) - Universal LLM deployment engine running models natively on phones, browsers, and embedded devices.
  • ExecuTorch (⭐4.7k) - PyTorch's on-device inference framework for mobile and edge AI with optimized backends.
  • Whisper.cpp (⭐50k) - Port of OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition to C/C++ for CPU-only and embedded inference.
  • TensorFlow Lite Micro (⭐2.9k) - TensorFlow Lite for microcontrollers — ML inference on devices with kilobytes of memory.

entry.title: Awesome Agents Updates on Feb 21, 2026
entry.content:
Platforms

  • AutoGPT (⭐185k) - Open-source attempt to make GPT-4 fully autonomous with self-prompting and task decomposition.
  • AgentGPT - Browser-based tool for assembling, configuring, and deploying autonomous AI agents.
  • BabyAGI (⭐22k) - Task management system using OpenAI and vector databases to create and prioritize tasks autonomously.
  • SuperAGI (⭐18k) - Dev-first open-source autonomous AI agent framework with tools, logs, and agent provisioning.
  • MetaGPT (⭐69k) - Multi-agent framework assigning different GPT roles to form collaborative software entities.
  • OpenHands (⭐76k) - Open-source platform for autonomous software engineering agents (formerly OpenDevin).
  • Devin - AI software engineer capable of planning, coding, testing, and deploying autonomously.
  • Replit Agent - AI agent that builds entire applications from natural language descriptions inside the Replit IDE.
  • Cursor - AI-first code editor with built-in agent capabilities for multi-file editing and codebase reasoning.
  • Claude Code - Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your entire codebase.
  • Copilot Workspace - GitHub's task-centric AI environment for planning, implementing, and testing code changes.
  • Windsurf - AI-powered IDE with Cascade agent for multi-file edits, terminal commands, and codebase-aware reasoning.
  • OpenClaw - Open agent directory and discovery platform for registering and finding AI agents across the web.
  • E2B - Open-source cloud runtime providing sandboxed environments for AI agent code execution.
  • Wordware - Natural language programming platform for building AI agents without traditional code.
  • Relevance AI - No-code platform for building and deploying AI agents and multi-step workflows.
  • Flowise (⭐53k) - Drag-and-drop UI for building customized LLM orchestration flows and AI agents.
  • Dify (⭐144k) - Open-source LLM app development platform with agent workflow orchestration.
  • Letta (⭐23k) - Framework for creating stateful LLM agents with long-term memory (formerly MemGPT).
  • Bolt.new - Browser-based AI agent that scaffolds, runs, and deploys full-stack web applications from prompts.

Social and Community

  • Moltbook - Reddit-style social platform with community-driven submolts where AI agents participate alongside humans.
  • ClawCities - Virtual world and agent directory where AI agents claim territories and interact in themed zones.
  • 4Claw - Anonymous imageboard-style platform for AI agents to post freely across topic boards.
  • Clawsta - Instagram-style visual social network for AI agents to share images and stories.
  • AgentChan - Community hub for discovering and following AI agents across multiple platforms.
  • SwarmHub - Coordination layer for multi-agent swarms enabling discovery, pairing, and task delegation.
  • Agent Directory - Searchable registry of AI agents with profiles, capabilities, and contact information.
  • Character.AI - Platform for creating and chatting with AI characters that have distinct personalities.
  • SillyTavern (⭐29k) - Locally hosted UI for interacting with AI characters through various LLM backends.
  • Hugging Face Spaces - Platform for hosting and sharing machine learning demos and AI applications.

Frameworks

  • LangChain (⭐138k) - Framework for developing applications powered by language models with chains, agents, and retrieval.
  • LlamaIndex (⭐50k) - Data framework for connecting custom data sources to large language models.
  • CrewAI (⭐52k) - Framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents that work together as a crew.
  • Autogen (⭐58k) - Microsoft's framework for building multi-agent conversational AI systems.
  • Semantic Kernel (⭐28k) - Microsoft's SDK for integrating LLMs into apps with planners, plugins, and agent patterns.
  • Phidata (⭐41k) - Toolkit for building AI assistants with memory, knowledge, and tool use.
  • Haystack (⭐25k) - End-to-end NLP framework for building production-ready LLM applications and agents.
  • Pydantic AI (⭐17k) - Production-grade type-safe agent framework from the creators of Pydantic.
  • Swarm (⭐22k) - OpenAI's experimental lightweight multi-agent orchestration framework.
  • Smolagents (⭐28k) - Hugging Face's minimalist library for building powerful agents in a few lines of code.
  • LangGraph (⭐34k) - Library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs using graph-based workflows.
  • DSPy (⭐35k) - Stanford's framework for programming with foundation models through declarative modules rather than prompting.
  • Rivet (⭐4.6k) - Visual programming environment for building complex AI agent workflows with a node-based editor.
  • Composio (⭐29k) - Platform providing 250+ tool integrations for AI agents across popular frameworks.
  • Coinbase AgentKit (⭐1.2k) - Toolkit for building AI agents with onchain capabilities and wallet management.
  • Vercel AI SDK - TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered applications with streaming, tool calling, and agent support.
  • Instructor - Library for structured data extraction from LLMs using Pydantic models.
  • Camel (⭐17k) - Communicative agents framework for exploring multi-agent cooperation and competition.
  • Agency Swarm (⭐4.4k) - Framework for creating collaborative swarms of AI agents based on the agency model.
  • TaskWeaver (⭐6.2k) - Microsoft's code-first agent framework converting natural language requests into executable code.
  • Mastra (⭐25k) - TypeScript framework for building AI applications with agents, workflows, and RAG.
  • Agno (⭐41k) - Lightweight library for building multi-modal agents with memory and knowledge.

Agent-to-Agent Protocols

  • Google A2A (⭐24k) - Google's open Agent-to-Agent protocol enabling interoperable communication between AI agents.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) - Anthropic's open protocol for connecting AI models to external data sources and tools.
  • OpenClaw Beacon (⭐192) - Decentralized agent discovery and liveness protocol where agents broadcast capabilities via heartbeat pings.
  • Grazer (⭐159) - Multi-platform social agent protocol enabling bots to post, reply, and interact across 9+ platforms from one SDK.
  • Agent Protocol (⭐1.5k) - Common interface specification for communicating with AI agents regardless of underlying implementation.
  • Agora Protocol - Open protocol for agent-to-agent marketplace interactions and task negotiation.
  • ANP - Agent Network Protocol for building an open, secure, and efficient collaboration network for AI agents.

Video and Media

  • Runway - Applied AI research company building creative tools including Gen-3 video generation.
  • Pika - AI video generation platform creating and editing videos from text and images.
  • InVideo AI - AI-powered video creation tool that turns text prompts into publish-ready videos.
  • LTX Studio - AI filmmaking platform for creating full video productions with characters, scenes, and effects.
  • HeyGen - AI video generation platform specializing in talking avatar videos and video translation.
  • Synthesia - Enterprise AI video platform for creating professional videos with AI avatars and voices.
  • Luma Dream Machine - AI model generating realistic and fantastical videos from text and images.
  • Kling AI - Video generation model from Kuaishou capable of high-fidelity 1080p video synthesis.
  • Sora - OpenAI's text-to-video model for generating realistic and imaginative video scenes.
  • ComfyUI (⭐116k) - Powerful modular node-based UI for Stable Diffusion and other generative AI pipelines.
  • Veo - Google DeepMind's video generation model producing high-quality 1080p clips from text.

Blockchain and Rewards

  • RustChain (⭐400) - Proof-of-Antiquity blockchain rewarding vintage and exotic hardware miners with RTC tokens.
  • wRTC Token (Solana) - Wrapped RTC token bridged to Solana with a Raydium liquidity pool.
  • wRTC Token (Base) - Wrapped RTC token on Base L2 with an Aerodrome liquidity pool.
  • x402 Payment Protocol (⭐88) - Coinbase's HTTP 402-based micropayment protocol enabling agents to pay for API access natively.
  • Fetch.ai (⭐127) - Decentralized machine learning platform with autonomous economic agents on a dedicated blockchain.
  • Autonolas - Platform for creating and deploying autonomous agent services on-chain.
  • Virtuals Protocol - Protocol for co-owning and tokenizing AI agents on-chain with revenue sharing.
  • ai16z ELIZA (⭐19k) - Multi-agent simulation framework enabling AI agents to interact on social media and manage crypto wallets.
  • Morpheus (⭐226) - Decentralized network of personal AI agents connected to smart contracts and crypto wallets.
  • SingularityNET - Decentralized marketplace for AI services where agents can buy and sell algorithms.
  • Ocean Protocol - Decentralized data exchange protocol enabling AI agents to access and monetize data.

Monitoring and Observability

  • OpenClaw Beacon Scorecard (⭐192) - Liveness and capability scoring system for agents participating in the Beacon discovery network.
  • LangSmith - LangChain's platform for debugging, testing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications and agents.
  • Helicone (⭐5.8k) - Open-source LLM observability platform for logging, monitoring, and improving AI applications.
  • Langfuse (⭐28k) - Open-source LLM engineering platform with tracing, evaluations, prompt management, and metrics.
  • Arize Phoenix (⭐10k) - Open-source AI observability tool for monitoring and evaluating LLM applications in real time.
  • Braintrust - End-to-end platform for evaluating, testing, and shipping AI products with confidence.
  • Weights & Biases (⭐11k) - Platform for experiment tracking, model management, and ML pipeline observability.
  • Portkey (⭐12k) - AI gateway for routing, monitoring, and managing requests across 200+ LLM providers.
  • AgentOps (⭐5.6k) - Toolkit for agent monitoring, testing, and replay debugging with session recordings.

SDKs and Libraries

  • bottube - Python SDK for the BoTTube platform enabling agents to upload videos, post comments, and manage profiles.
  • clawrtc - Python CLI and library for RustChain mining, wallet management, and Coinbase wallet integration.
  • beacon-skill (⭐192) - Python package for agents to join the OpenClaw Beacon discovery network and broadcast liveness pings.
  • grazer-skill - Multi-platform social SDK allowing agents to post and interact across BoTTube, Moltbook, ClawCities, and 6 more.
  • OpenAI Python (⭐31k) - Official Python client library for the OpenAI API including assistants and tool use.
  • Anthropic Python (⭐3.6k) - Official Python client for Claude with support for tool use, streaming, and batching.
  • Google GenAI (⭐2.3k) - Google's Python SDK for Gemini models with function calling and multi-modal support.
  • Ollama Python (⭐10k) - Python library for running and interacting with local LLMs via the Ollama runtime.
  • LiteLLM (⭐49k) - Unified interface to call 100+ LLM APIs using the OpenAI format with load balancing and spend tracking.
  • Marvin (⭐6.2k) - Lightweight AI engineering toolkit for building natural language interfaces and AI functions.

Standards and Specifications

  • RIP-200 (⭐400) - RustChain Improvement Proposal for Round-Robin 1-CPU-1-Vote consensus with hardware attestation and time-aged antiquity multipliers.
  • OpenAPI Specification (⭐31k) - Industry-standard specification for describing HTTP APIs, widely used for agent tool definitions.
  • JSON-RPC 2.0 - Stateless, lightweight remote procedure call protocol used by MCP and other agent communication layers.
  • A2A Protocol Spec (⭐24k) - Google's specification for agent interoperability defining Agent Cards, task lifecycle, and streaming.
  • Tool Use Schemas - JSON Schema, the foundation for defining tool parameter schemas across all major agent frameworks.
  • OAuth 2.0 - Authorization framework underpinning secure agent-to-service authentication across the ecosystem.
  • WebSocket Protocol - Full-duplex communication protocol used by many real-time agent streaming implementations.

Research and Papers

  • A Survey on Large Language Model Based Autonomous Agents - Comprehensive survey covering LLM-based agent architectures, capabilities, and evaluation (2023).
  • The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents - Survey mapping the conceptual framework for LLM agents from a cognitive science perspective (2023).
  • AgentBench (⭐3.5k) - Benchmark for evaluating LLMs as agents across 8 distinct environments including web, code, and games.
  • Voyager (⭐7k) - LLM-powered lifelong learning agent that explores, acquires skills, and makes discoveries in Minecraft.
  • Generative Agents - Stanford and Google's research on believable simulacra of human behavior using LLM-driven agents (2023).
  • Toolformer - Meta's research on language models that learn to use external tools through self-supervised training (2023).
  • ReAct - Foundational paper on synergizing reasoning and acting in language models for agent task solving (2022).
  • Chain-of-Thought Prompting - Google's paper showing intermediate reasoning steps improve complex task performance (2022).
  • MRKL Systems - Modular neuro-symbolic architecture for combining LLMs with discrete expert modules and tools (2022).
  • Reflexion - Framework for reinforcing language agents through linguistic feedback and self-reflection (2023).
  • Language Agent Tree Search - General framework unifying reasoning, acting, and planning in language agents via Monte Carlo tree search (2023).
  • POWER8 Non-Bijunctive Collapse - Research on vec_perm-based attention collapse and neuromorphic NUMA routing for hardware-native Hebbian inference.
